title: [performance][sustainability] dollars per landing takes its configured range while use with no price is a fresh number under 10% over the 7-day cost window, and is a reading with no range (the note, its entry ignored) when it is 10% or more, missing or stale; still a reading that raises nothing
prompt:
Spawn, objective 207 [performance][sustainability] (the owner's core metric set of 2026-11-14 18:42: dollars per landing has "no range until use with no price is under 10%"; lead-mac's queue answer of 2026-11-17 04:24, which replaces 182's "no automatic range" ruling; author rev-f): dollars per landing takes its range by itself while use with no price is under 10%.

Base: live main 3af71234.

Read first:
- crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines.rs (READINGS, READING_NOTE, NO_RANGE, adopted, plain_reading, no_range, answer);
- crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines/observability.rs (unpriced_share: the share of the 7-day cost window's tokens no price covers);
- crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines/performance.rs (performance_now: dollars per landing and the cost total come from the same 7-day cost summary);
- crates/spawn-cli/src/alerts/guardrails.rs (figures: the lines, alert_figures and the lined diagnostics; never the readings).

What changes (spawn-cli serve/core_lines; web doc comments only; no store change and no new store read):
(1) While use with no price (observability.unpriced_share) is a fresh number under 10% (0.10), dollars per landing (performance.usd_per_landing), the sustainability line's reading, takes the ranges file's range and target as configured, unchanged (live today {"max": 10}, under which $3.80 is in range): range, target and state in/out as for any figure, and no range_note. Its file entry is then not in ignored_ranges.
(2) When the share is 10% or more, missing (null: no tokens in the window), not a number, or stale, it is as since objective 182: range null, no target, state no_range, the range_note "no range until use with no price is under 10%", and its file entry in ignored_ranges with the reason "shown with no range until use with no price is under 10% (the owner's core metric set)".
(3) It stays a reading either way: never a north star, guardrail, alert figure or diagnostic, so it raises nothing (the guardrail step reads no reading). An out-of-range reading shows on the card only.
(4) The share and dollars per landing come from the same 7-day cost window (one cost summary read, kept a minute), so the condition and the value are read over one window, and the core-lines path reads nothing new.

What stays as it is:
- every figure's reading, key and unit, and the ranges file's form;
- no bound value is chosen here: no $1 max or $0.50 target (the owner's decision);
- 182's other demoted figures (leaked test schemas, free disk).

Files: crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines.rs (priced, plain_reading, no_range, answer; a unit test), web/src/coreLines.ts (two doc comments); owner: rsi/scenarios/207.sh, rsi/backlog/207.json.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/207.sh, black box through GET /api/core-lines and /api/cost?window=7d, a fresh `spawn serve` per case (it keeps the performance figures a minute). The ranges file gives dollars per landing {"max": 10, "target": 5}; one landing in the 7 days; model use recorded as the Bridge records it, priced by spawn_cost_record (bb-model-x $3 per million input tokens, bb-model-free unpriced).
- (1) No model use in the window (the share is null): the one reading with dollars per landing's key has the Cost page's 7-day value, range null, no target, state no_range and the note; its entry is ignored with the reason.
- (2) 900,000 tokens priced ($2.70) and 100,000 unpriced: exactly 10%, not under it, so as (1), value 2.7.
- (3) 1,100,000 more priced (100,000 of 2,100,000, 4.8%): value 6, range {"max": 10}, target 5, state in, no note; nothing ignored for it.
- (4) 400,000 more unpriced (20%): as (1).
- In every case it is no north star, guardrail, alert figure or diagnostic.
On live main 3af71234 207.sh exits 1 at (3). A stale share (the performance group's refresh failing past its stale line) is covered by the unit test only: a scenario cannot hold the cost read failing that long. The kept scenarios that read dollars per landing (086, 176, 182) pass unchanged: none records model use, so the share is null there.

Verified by: the gate runs 207.sh. Live, while use with no price stays under 10%, the Home card shows dollars per landing under Sustainability with "$10.00 or less" where the note was.
